caption: The image shows a decorative round plate with a scalloped edge, predominantly rendered in shades of gray indicating the photograph is in black and white. The plate features an intricate border adorned with detailed illustrations of flowers, leaves, and clusters of fruit. At the top of the inner border, there is an image of an open book with an eye above it, and on the book the words "KNOWLEDGE IS POWER" are visible. The center of the plate contains a large, jagged-edged medallion within which a detailed scene is depicted. This scene shows a group of various animals— a lamb, lion, goat, leopard, and a dog— positioned together on grassy ground. Among the animals, two are depicted standing upright, possibly personified and dressed to resemble people, and one is holding a banner or scroll. Above the group, the dove is shown flying and the words "PEACE ON EARTH" are inscribed in an arc. Below the scene, on a scroll-like motif, is a line of text that reads, "Give us this day our daily bread." The overall composition is symmetrical and finely detailed, with each section containing densely packed visual elements.
title: Plate - "Millenium"
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
